author: iDiamondPorkchop
body:
Alright, so when EmeraldSword(InsertNumbersHere) banned me, he said it was because I had too many, he said specifically 15. But one of my infractions was for "enforcing temp-ban," so that really doesn't count as an infraction!!! So that means I technically only have 14 infractions, and I should still have one more chance! Please let me come back. If you let me come back with 14 infractions, then I have one more chance. And if I get one more infraction to add up to 15, you can ban me again, and even forum ban me if you like. I promise if I come back I will fulfill my promise and not get another infraction.

EDIT: Again, I am a special case, please don't lock this saying "forums aren't the place for this."
I just want one more chance because I love Avicus so much. <3
~Diamondporkchop3

replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
It's not solely based on the exact number.

It's the idea that when you receive multiple infractions regarding chat misconduct it's obvious that the player isn't going to abide by the rules of the server.
